expo.name: MARKET LINK EXPRESS
expo.description: MARKET LINK EXPRESS - 专业的快递配送服务平台，提供快速、安全、可靠的包裹配送服务。支持实时追踪、多语言界面和智能路线规划。

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MARKET LINK EXPRESS需要访问您的位置信息以提供准确的配送服务和包裹追踪功能。
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MARKET LINK EXPRESS需要访问您的相机以扫描二维码和拍摄包裹验证照片。
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MARKET LINK EXPRESS需要访问您的相册以保存二维码和包裹图片。
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: MARKET LINK EXPRESS需要访问您的相册以保存付款二维码。

plugins.photosPermission: MARKET LINK EXPRESS needs photo library access so you can upload payment proofs, order review photos, and product images when you choose to select a photo.
plugins.cameraPermission: MARKET LINK EXPRESS needs camera access to scan QR codes and take package verification photos.

plugins.photosPermission: MARKET LINK EXPRESS needs permission to save payment QR codes and shipping labels to your photo gallery when you tap Save.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: MARKET LINK EXPRESS needs permission to save payment QR codes and shipping labels to your photo gallery when you tap Save.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: MARKET LINK EXPRESS needs access to your location to provide accurate delivery services and track packages.
